svg.title: Licensing Operational Records to AI Labs
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-ai-data-license-roadmap; chapter number: 12; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Licensing Operational Records to AI Labs; subtitle: License copies, never the asset, and name every category; caption: Jason Varner quotes $100K to $3M-plus payouts for anonymized operational records, and micro1 reports two to three weeks from owner interest to a completed license with payout around 60 days out.; assumptions note: Week labels sequence the reported steps; the only durations practitioners gave are 2-3 weeks to completion and payout around 60 days out. Payouts are driven by exclusivity.; note: Attributed to Jason Varner, micro1, Archive Trove, OneHourProfessor and Mayer Brown.; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Inventory operational records; deliverable: IT tickets first, since each holds a problem, an action and a fix, plus Slack exports; gate: Pricing records treated as exposed even after names are removed; week: Week 2; title: Name every category in the contract; deliverable: Records, outputs, embeddings and models named, with exclusivity decided against selling to multiple labs; gate: Deletion clause reaches labels, caches, backups and checkpoints and decides the trained model's fate; week: Week 3; title: Close the license; deliverable: Completed license inside the 2-3 week window micro1 reports; gate: Retention, copies and models after termination settled before export; week: Week 4; title: Track payout and model access; deliverable: Payout expected around 60 days out; gate: Diligence, regulator access and audit access locked for every model version
